note: One reusable rule candidate emerged from the slider tick-alignment fix; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: Position slider tick labels proportionally to the underlying value range, not evenly across the track.
candidates.rationale: Evenly spacing tick labels made the profile-page budget slider thumb appear over the wrong value. Aligning each label at `((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100%` keeps the thumb and label visually matched across the range.

candidates.text: When fixing a visual layout bug, add a regression test that asserts the presence or structure of the corrected element even when pixel-perfect alignment must be verified manually.
candidates.rationale: The slider fix included a test that verifies the tick labels are rendered, guarding against accidental removal or reversion to the old even-spaced layout.
